<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex70022023-09-261" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="[Colophon (25a8-9) (p. 129:8-9)]"/>
                  <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5169"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3693">sdud pa tshig bcad shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa tshigs su bcad pa</rs>'i ti ka snying po gsal byed</rs> zhes bya ba | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5702">dpal gyi 'byung gnas zhang gad rin <lb n="25a9"/> po che</rs> ru <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6823">phyug po mi nyag pa</rs>s yon bdag mdzad nas | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4072">shag kya'i dge slong grags pa tshul khrims</rs> kyis me mo klang gi lo<anchor xml:id="a1"/> la | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6964"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5830"><abbr>slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs</abbr></rs> kyi ti ka</rs> dang mthun par mdzad pa ¦ rdzogs s+ho || Iti || dge'o || bkra shis s+ho || ||</seg></TEI>
source: 3_070_02 Shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa'i Tik+ka snying po gsal ba.xml
